description: Canonical, immutable reference configuration for the first untouched continuous full-history SingleAnchor baseline run (XAUUSD/dukascopy/Cfd, 2019-01-01..2026-06-30) on the qualified continuous native history. Every effective value required by that run is stated explicitly here; nothing may be inferred from host defaults or fixture values. This is the single source of truth for baseline values: the decision audit (baseline-decision-audit.json) records how each value was approved and must agree with this file, and the human-auditable rendering is ../BASELINE_CONTRACT.md.
scope: the first untouched continuous full-history SingleAnchor baseline only; later optimization/sensitivity/research configurations may differ from these values but must never modify this file or be presented as the frozen baseline
canonicalization: The baseline contract identity is the SHA-256 of this file's UTF-8 text content with CRLF normalized to LF, lower-case hex, exactly as the tracked baseline-decision-audit.json field frozenBaselineContractSha256 records it and tests/SingleAnchor/BaselineContractTests.cs and tests/SingleAnchor/BaselineDecisionAuditTests.cs verify it. The identity is deliberately not stored in this file (that would be circular); it is reported by scripts/Get-SingleAnchorBaselineInvocation.ps1 and recorded with the future run evidence.
identityScope: The identity covers this file's complete content (LF-normalized): the frozen values, their authorities and this documentation together. Editing any part of this file changes the identity on purpose, so no value or authority can change unnoticed; the audit register, the human-auditable contract and the pinned expectations must be updated in the same commit and the new identity recorded.

qualifiedDataIdentity.note: The identity is bound to the tracked PR #13 continuous-history evidence; the run must not fall back to the Oanda market default, the 2014 fixture dates, unrestricted/no-session-map behaviour or any monthly qualification folder.

runHost.parameterChannel: -Parameters (comma-separated key:value pairs; every single-anchor-* key below is passed explicitly)
runHost.runEvidence: the authoritative run passes -RunEvidence so run-backtest.ps1 writes marketlab-run-invocation.json into the run directory before LEAN is launched (resolved absolute inputs, exact parameter pairs, allow flags, launcher argv, config/algorithm hashes, Git HEAD and dirty state, the qualified runtime binary hashes) and marketlab-run-outcome.json after the run (LEAN exit code, final helper exit code, the engine-error check and count, the data-monitor result and whether the runtime binaries changed); the classifier refuses a run directory without either file
runHost.baselineContractParameter: -BaselineContract MarketLab\config\baseline-contract.json (with -RunEvidence: the contract hash is computed and must equal the register pin before LEAN launches)
runHost.baselineRegisterParameter: -BaselineRegister MarketLab\config\baseline-decision-audit.json (with -RunEvidence: the pin the contract hash must match)
runHost.note: The helper defaults for -AlgorithmLocation (upstream QuantConnect.Algorithm.CSharp.dll), -Config and -DataFolder are not relied on; the authoritative run passes every helper input explicitly. -AllowEngineErrors must be absent.

fixedImplementationContract.description: Effective runtime behavior of the host that is not a LEAN [Parameter], so it cannot be bound on the command line; it is still part of the frozen baseline and the drift checks assert every value below against the live implementation.
fixedImplementationContract.sessionJunctionWindow: 17:00:00 <= t < 18:00:00 (start inclusive, end exclusive); a gap that fully contains this interval starts a new source session
fixedImplementationContract.benchmark: SetBenchmark on the traded symbol itself, so no unrelated benchmark data is required (the absent hour file is the enumerated known auxiliary failed request)
fixedImplementationContract.sessionMapSemantics: with the frozen session map the first and last five minutes of every complete session are quote-only, and the final dataset-end session has an opening buffer only
fixedImplementationContract.binding: SINGLE_ANCHOR_VNEXT_STRATEGY.md section 1.1; SINGLE_ANCHOR_RESEARCH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 5; SINGLE_ANCHOR_VNEXT_IMPLEMENTATION.md sections 4 and 8.2; tests/SingleAnchor/BaselineContractTests.cs

marginContract.matchedHedgeMarginRule: matched BUY/SELL Gold volume has zero margin; only the uncovered side is charged
marginContract.uncoveredVolumeMarginRule: uncovered lots * contract size * weighted-average open price / leverage, projected post-fill including the candidate fill
marginContract.marginCallSemantics: at or below it no new position may be opened; normal basket exits may still execute while the account is above stop-out
marginContract.stopOutSemantics: terminal for the research path: record stop-out, mark survival failed and stop strategy research execution; no broker liquidation sequence is simulated
marginContract.negativeEquityHandling: an account with open positions and negative equity is terminal stop-out, including the zero-used-margin matched-hedge case
marginContract.note: The approved PR #3 contract; the host instantiates these values itself from MarginParameters and refuses another symbol, security type or point value. Do not change the margin/account implementation for this baseline.

expectedCategories: expected-source-absent-calendar-day: an always-open XAUUSD/dukascopy tick partition the qualified continuous tree does not contain, inside the frozen window
known-non-strategy-auxiliary-request: the benchmark hour file the host does not otherwise need, recorded explicitly

recorded-absence-after-terminated-horizon: a source-absent day after the actually processed horizon of an AccountStopOut run (the intended modeled terminal survival outcome); it was never requested because the run ended, and it is recorded rather than treated as missing qualified data
invalidatingCategories: unexpected-missing-qualified-partition: a failed request for a partition the qualified continuous tree contains
unexpected-out-of-window-request: a failed XAUUSD/dukascopy partition request outside the frozen window
unexpected-unknown-request: any other failed request path
unexpected-unrequested-absence: a source-absent calendar day within the run's actually processed horizon that was not requested at all
failed-request-accounting-mismatch: the engine data-monitor failed-request count and the failed-request lines disagree, so not every failed request is accounted for
contract-evidence-mismatch: the run's auxiliary failed-request count or the tracked continuous-history evidence no longer agrees with the frozen contract
failedDataRequestPolicy.terminationRule: A baseline run that completes normally, or that ends through the intended modeled survival outcome (AccountStopOut, the terminal target-account stop-out the baseline exists to reveal), is classifiable: for AccountStopOut the expected-absence coverage is bounded by the run's actually processed horizon (the failure quote's day, clamped to the frozen window), source-absent days after that horizon are recorded as not-requested-because-the-run-ended and are not missing qualified data, and a source-absent day within the horizon that was not requested at all still invalidates the baseline. A normally completed run must also have a clean persisted helper outcome (LEAN exit 0, helper exit 0, the engine-error check performed with zero engine ERROR:: lines); an AccountStopOut run must have exactly the modeled terminal outcome shape (LEAN exit 1, helper exit 1, no classifiable engine-error finding). Any other run-ending condition (a strategy invariant, hard-BE verification, data-quality or session-map failure, AccountSurvival, a LEAN runtime error or any other failure kind) is NOT an approved baseline outcome: the classifier refuses such a run as a controlled failure and it cannot receive failed-data qualification EXPECTED.
failedDataRequestPolicy.rule: Every LEAN failed-data request of the future baseline must be captured and classified against the frozen contract and the qualified continuous tree. Only expected-source-absent calendar days inside the frozen window and the enumerated known auxiliary paths may be accepted as expected; a failed request for a partition that carries qualified rows, an out-of-window request, an unknown request, or a frozen-window source-absent day that was not requested at all invalidates the baseline run. -AllowEngineErrors remains prohibited.
failedDataRequestPolicy.note: Do not assume the strategy baseline reproduces the qualification probe's failed-request list without checking; the post-run classification script derives the expected absence from the data tree and checks the actual run behavior against it.

runOutcomeContract.preRunEvidence: marketlab-run-invocation.json, written by run-backtest.ps1 -RunEvidence before LEAN is launched: resolved absolute inputs and hashes, this contract's path/SHA-256 and the register pin (verified equal before launch), the Git HEAD and dirty state, and the qualified runtime binary hashes
runOutcomeContract.postRunEvidence: marketlab-run-outcome.json, written by run-backtest.ps1 -RunEvidence after the run: LEAN exit code, final helper exit code, whether the engine-error check ran and its count, the data-monitor result the helper used, and whether the runtime binaries changed during the run; bound to the pre-run file by its SHA-256
runOutcomeContract.normalCompletion: LEAN exit 0 and helper exit 0 with the engine-error check performed and zero engine ERROR:: lines, the failed-request count equal to the data monitor, and the runtime binaries unchanged
runOutcomeContract.accountStopOut: LEAN exit 1 and helper exit 1 with no classifiable engine-error finding (the helper's engine-error check runs only for exit-0 runs; the terminal stop-out is defined by the strategy result's failure kind), the failed-request count equal to the data monitor, and the runtime binaries unchanged
runOutcomeContract.invalid: any other exit-code shape, a missing or mismatched outcome record, an engine ERROR:: line in a completed run, a changed runtime binary, or a dirty working tree at launch; the classifier refuses the run as a controlled failure
runOutcomeContract.provenanceLimit: the evidence binds the run directory to the contract identity, the qualified tree and the qualified runtime; the repository commit is recorded in the pre-run evidence and checked for a clean tree, while the operator's shell history is outside the repository's control and remains part of the run audit narrative

steps: Build Release: pwsh -File MarketLab\scripts\build.ps1, then dotnet build MarketLab\src\SingleAnchor\MarketLab.SingleAnchor.csproj --configuration Release

Report the contract identity and render the exact invocation: pwsh -File MarketLab\scripts\Get-SingleAnchorBaselineInvocation.ps1 (refuses to render if the contract file hash does not equal the register's frozenBaselineContractSha256)

Run the baseline helper exactly as rendered, with -AllowMissingData, -RunEvidence, -BaselineContract and -BaselineRegister (Release, SingleAnchorVNextAlgorithm, MarketLab/config/backtesting.json, the continuous data folder, 2019-01-01..2026-06-30); do not pass -AllowEngineErrors. -RunEvidence writes marketlab-run-invocation.json (with the verified contract hash, register pin, Git HEAD/dirty state and runtime binary hashes) before LEAN is launched and marketlab-run-outcome.json (LEAN/helper exit codes, engine-error check, data-monitor result and runtime-binary stability) after it

Classify every failed data request and verify the whole chain: pwsh -File MarketLab\scripts\Test-SingleAnchorBaselineFailedData.ps1 -RunDirectory <the run directory printed by the helper>. The classifier refuses any run whose pre-run evidence names a different contract/pin/machine or a dirty repository, requires a clean helper outcome for a completed run (or the exact AccountStopOut terminal shape), verifies the data tree against its composition manifest and the manifest against the replay qualification record, reconciles the failed-request files with the engine's data-monitor count, and writes the verified identities into the classification record

Record with the run evidence: the contract identity, the repository commit, the runtime binary hashes, the full parameter block from the run's storage\single-anchor\results.json, the session-map/data provenance block and the classification record
runProcedure.exactRunCommand: pwsh -File MarketLab\scripts\run-backtest.ps1 -Configuration Release -Config MarketLab/config/backtesting.json -AlgorithmTypeName SingleAnchorVNextAlgorithm -AlgorithmLanguage CSharp -AlgorithmLocation MarketLab\src\SingleAnchor\bin\Release\MarketLab.SingleAnchor.dll -DataFolder E:\MarketLab\data\lean\xauusd-dukascopy -Parameters "single-anchor-symbol:XAUUSD,single-anchor-market:dukascopy,single-anchor-security-type:Cfd,single-anchor-start-date:2019-01-01,single-anchor-end-date:2026-06-30,single-anchor-cash:20000,single-anchor-session-map:marketlab-sessions/xauusd-sessions.json,single-anchor-step-percent:0.25,single-anchor-base-lot:0.10,single-anchor-normal-trade-count:4,single-anchor-hard-be-ceiling-percent:4.478,single-anchor-escape-enabled:true,single-anchor-escape-profit-units:0.05,single-anchor-escape-minimum-open-positions:2,single-anchor-fixed-tp-units:0,single-anchor-trailing-enabled:true,single-anchor-trailing-activation-units:0.50,single-anchor-trailing-drop-units:0.25,single-anchor-commission-buffer:0,single-anchor-point-value-per-lot:100,single-anchor-volume-step:0.01,single-anchor-minimum-volume:0.01,single-anchor-maximum-volume:50,single-anchor-commission-per-lot:0,single-anchor-slippage:0,single-anchor-projected-spread:0.50,single-anchor-buy-swap-per-lot-per-day:0,single-anchor-sell-swap-per-lot-per-day:0,single-anchor-research-account:true,single-anchor-margin-enabled:true" -AllowMissingData -RunEvidence -BaselineContract MarketLab\config\baseline-contract.json -BaselineRegister MarketLab\config\baseline-decision-audit.json
runProcedure.runEvidenceRequirements: The future baseline run must be launched only from the reviewed and merged freeze commit and must persist, inside its run directory, the pre-run invocation evidence written by run-backtest.ps1 -RunEvidence (resolved absolute inputs, exact parameter pairs, allow flags, launcher argv, config/algorithm hashes, this contract's SHA-256 and the register pin verified equal, the Git HEAD and dirty state and the qualified runtime binary hashes), the post-run outcome evidence (LEAN exit code, final helper exit code, the engine-error check and count, the data-monitor result, and whether the runtime binaries changed during the run) and the failed-data classification record that binds the run directory to this contract's identity, to the verified tree's composition manifest and its replay qualification record. The run audit additionally records the full effective parameter block written by the strategy to storage\single-anchor\results.json and the session-map/data provenance block.
runProcedure.notYetRun: The full-history strategy baseline is deliberately not run by the freeze commit; it is launched exactly once after this contract is reviewed and merged.

relationshipToLaterResearch.baseline: This contract is the immutable reference configuration for the first untouched full-history baseline; it describes the configuration itself, not any result or performance.
relationshipToLaterResearch.laterConfigurations: Later optimization/sensitivity/research configurations must be separate, clearly identified configurations (for example under MarketLab\work or a documented research config) that record which values differ from this contract. They may intentionally vary parameters, but they must never rewrite, edit or silently reuse this file as their own configuration, and a result produced under different values must never be reported as generated by this contract.
relationshipToLaterResearch.sensitivities: Execution assumptions (ProjectedSpread, Slippage) and geometry (StepPercent, HardBreakevenCeilingPercent, BaseLot) remain candidates for later sensitivity studies under the approved research hierarchy; those studies do not change this frozen baseline.
